ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is an isoline distribution map of a local region of China; the isoline values are roughly 12, 14, 16, 18, etc., showing a large-area continuous distribution and reflecting the spatial differences of the “maximum negative anomaly” of daily average temperature. The prompt explains that daily average temperature anomaly is the difference between the daily average temperature and the average value of daily average temperatures within a year, so “negative anomaly” means that the daily average temperature is lower than the perennial average level. Reasoning: a large-area significantly low temperature distribution, if corresponding to a meteorological disaster, usually refers to a cold wave or low-temperature chilling damage. When a cold wave forms, strong cold air moves southward, and a cold front often forms at the leading edge of the cold air; the rear part of the main body of cold air is controlled by cold high pressure, corresponding in weather system to an anticyclone. Therefore, the formation of this meteorological disaster is related to a cold front and an anticyclone.
